lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for most kinds of changes because almost all categories have only 1 test so far.
home, new_flow changes did not work, consistently showing negative impacts across 2 tests (-2.6% average after noise correction).
finish, new_screen and choose_path, hint each won 1 test, but a second test of each showed no clear effect, so evidence remains mixed.
Predictions were generally too high overall compared to actual noise-corrected results.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Pet Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend picker screen to use a stage layout showcasing the desktop pet on a virtual pedestal with enhanced selection controls.
candidates.why: Adoption step drop-off is high (66.0% conversion, 89s median). A stage presentation gives visual prominence and excitement during pet selection.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Choose the pet personality and appearance that will keep you company on your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns friend picker screen while maintaining its required function.

candidates.score_note: Target step has highest drop-off; adoption redesign previously showed strong +8% lift, but evidence is thin and cost is high.

candidates.title: Post-Customization Sign-In Flow Reorder
candidates.change: Moves sign-in screen after pet selection and photo upload so users build emotional investment before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently happens before pet creation where users are less invested. Deferring sign-in improves overall completion.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Custom Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your pet choice and sync across your devices.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Flow reordering carries high risk of negative impact based on past home new_flow tests.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Style Selector Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated personality selection screen before adoption certificate generation, letting users select pet temperament options.
candidates.why: Adoption takes significant time (89s median) and lacks intermediate steps to configure pet behavior before final desktop deployment.

new_pet_personality.headline: Choose Pet Behavior Style
new_pet_personality.body: Pick how your pet acts on your desktop: energetic explorer, calm desk companion, or playful buddy.

guard.reason: Adding a new personality selection screen inside onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen increases step count and cost, with mixed confidence for new screen additions.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Actions Intro Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a split layout clearly highlighting desktop interaction shortcuts (hide, summon, chat).
candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries after onboarding about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on their desktop.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to hide, chat, or access quick controls. Drag your pet anywhere on screen.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout and copy is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from both funnel and support emails, but redesign requires full screen changes.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Guarantee Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly inform returning users that existing pets will be automatically restored upon signing in.
candidates.why: Support theme analysis identified 8 user emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Log into your account to automatically sync and restore all your saved desktop pets and preferences.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to explain pet sync is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy fix supported by 8 support emails and positive past sign_in copy tests.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Trait Bonus Unlock Incentive
candidates.change: Adds a badge incentive highlight on pet selection promoting unlockable starter desktop accessories.
candidates.why: Enhances emotional pull and motivation during the adoption step where the biggest drop-off (66.0% conversion) occurs.

pick_friend.hint: Special Offer: Completing setup today unlocks bonus desktop accessories for your new companion!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions a special offer and bonus accessories, violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Setup Wait Info
candidates.change: Displays animated progress details and display setup reassurance on the waiting screen while pet assets load.
candidates.why: Support reports instances where pet fails to appear or app stalls, and waiting median time is 201s.

waiting.headline: Rendering Desktop Overlay
waiting.body: Configuring display drivers and desktop screen bounds for seamless pet movement...

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen details and progress indicators is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High evidence matching 201s wait time and stalling support mail; previous wait_info test was positive.

candidates.title: Split Layout Path Selection View
candidates.change: Changes path selection screen to a split layout comparing pre-made visual pets versus instant AI custom generation.
candidates.why: Choose path takes 8s median / 514s mean, indicating hesitation when deciding how to create or select a pet.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Adopt?
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-made companion from our collection or create a custom pet from your photos.

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay Control Toast Notification
candidates.change: Adds an actionable hint tip on the home intro screen detailing shortcut hotkeys for hiding and revealing the pet.
candidates.why: Addresses post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling and toggling desktop pet visibility.

home_intro.hint: Quick Tip: Press Alt+P anytime to hide or bring your pet back to the front of your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding control hints to the home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Supported by emails, but notification changes previously resulted in negative lift.

candidates.title: Photo Generation Fallback Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Provides reassurance hint on photo upload explaining safe fallback options if image processing fails or stalls.
candidates.why: Support logs 3 emails regarding failed or distorted custom pet photo generation during setup.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit photos. If processing takes long, standard companion features will auto-apply so you won't get stuck.

guard.reason: Requests personal photos from the user.

lessons_next: sign_in, copy changes consistently worked, winning both tests with an average noise-corrected lift of +3.1%.
home, new_flow changes consistently failed, showing negative impacts across 2 tests (-2.6% average after noise correction).
home, wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction).
Evidence remains mixed for finish, new_screen, choose_path, hint, and adoption, redesign, as each kind had 1 winning test and 1 test with no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories with only 1 test completed.
Predictions were generally too high overall compared to actual noise-corrected results.
